facts.fact: 港湾小馆的 date-night 布局、cold clammy 的手——Erica 面谈后 Zak 的首次坦白局；她一句「就算复合我们也 fine」被他反将：你被亏待惯了吗？
facts.anchor: “But are you so used to being treated like shit that you’d say it’s fine if I did?”

facts.fact: 他要的不是她的宽容是怒气（I'd rather you were a little pissed with me. So I know I matter）——Roddie 的情报：她被出轨两次（就我们所知）；点 crab cakes 与 ravioli。
facts.anchor: When I got back to the shop, Roddie said to me, ‘You know my dad cheated on her twice? That we know of.’

facts.fact: 他的自供：tank 里除了爸没油了（leaving him with Roddie 都应激）、I'm not a catch——「但我不要 Erica。我要的是你。这看起来不可能。这让我难过」；crab cakes 吃出 sawdust 味。
facts.anchor: I’m really fucking lonely, and that made the idea of getting back with Erica tempting for a short minute.

facts.fact: 她的让步清单：为怀孕结婚、为他迁蒙特利尔、为哺乳期容忍出轨——「为他人做让步是我的半生；为回岛我不会再让——除非是我自己想要的，而我不知道我要什么」。
facts.anchor: I married Joel because I was pregnant with Shelby. I moved to Montreal because that’s where he was going to school.

facts.fact: 红线宣言：never another baby（已有两个，不再生）——他深处理想要孩子；「他为了不想要的孩子把我扔掉，你还问我敢不敢 all-in？我不能」；fuck you for making me think I should——她自认致命弱点：想成为他需要的一切（vessel/therapist/instrument of comfort）。
facts.anchor: My ex-husband blew up the family we had by starting a new one with someone else.

facts.fact: 拥抱里的修复：tainted memories 与 missed opportunities 的哀悼转成可承受的酸；「我哭的不是 Joel 的未来，是错过的岔路」；pity party 互怼（No balloons. No clowns. / Just you.）；protect yourself 否则我会拿走你愿意给的一切——「谢谢假装为 Erica 心碎，我需要那个」（她：没假装）——章末 make-up sex 提议让他喊 Check! 压过全餐厅。
facts.anchor: “You throw a truly pitiful pity party. No balloons. No clowns.”
